text: The Western Australia (WA) initiative combines the AWARE program and the Disaster Ready Fund (DRF) to enhance disaster risk reduction. AWARE is a state-run program providing competitive grants to local governments to build capacity and preparedness. The DRF, a federal initiative, invests up to $1 billion over five years to fund resilience and risk reduction projects, with a focus on systemic risk mitigation and infrastructure. DFES coordinates these efforts, aligning them with national priorities to address natural hazards such as bushfires, cyclones, and floods.
